item.title: LOT-127: mark an MP conversation unread from the reader
item.body:
LOT-127
Closes #218
Claim: mac/lot-127

**Mac check needed** (spec, "Mac check needed"): iPhone and iPad, light, dark, Dynamic Type XL, on a test account.

### Problem
A member could not mark a private conversation unread: LOT-058 merged the engine write, no screen offered it (GAP-116).

### Cause
The action needs the `nonlu.php` link, which only a conversation page carries. The app dropped it: `ReaderPage` did not keep `TopicPageMetadata.markUnreadURL`.

### Change
- "Marquer comme non lu" in the reader's secondary menu, when the page has HFR's own link and an account is current (port of `OnlineMessagesTableViewController.m` `markUnread`, `:888-913`, entry `:805-807` @ 2440d79).
- One write through `TopicFlagFlow.markUnread`: session checked first, success only on HFR's own sentence, never resent.
- Confirmed: the list shows HFR's sentence, the conversation closes, the page on screen reloads. The row shows unread at once, also if that reload fails.
- Failed or unconfirmed: "Action impossible" alert in the reader, row unchanged. If the member already left the reader, the list shows it.

Why this wide and no wider: mark unread only. Delete and group members are LOT-181 (#421, M5), so the issue's title, its delete criterion and CAP-N1 belong there. No swipe on MP rows: legacy has none, list rows carry no link (`R13u1`, `R13b`: no `nonlu`), and fetching a thread to get it could mark it read (LOT-126 pending capture).

`column = selected == nil ? .sidebar : .detail` in `MessagesRootView` also runs when the member goes back or a session closes the conversation. It is the system's own value there, but no unit test reads it: part of the Mac check.

### Tests
`MarkUnreadTests` (19 cases): `RA1` carries the URL `W18` requested and `R21` has none; the live writer takes `markUnread`'s path and stops at the session check with no request; one write, a second tap sends nothing; five failures never shown as done and not resent; `R13b` row unread after the reload; mark kept through a failed reload, dropped by a later load or the last page; an older load does not clear it; another open conversation stays open.

- Full app suite green at this head on iPhone 18 Pro iOS 27.0 (990 cases, unsigned). iPad run pending.
- Shown to fail without the change: mutation run in progress, 16 mutations; results posted in a comment on this PR. Not claimed here until then.
- Nothing reaches HFR: writes are scripted, and the one real session never logged in and stops before any request.
- SwiftLint not run locally (not installed): line length and type body checked by hand; CI is the arbiter.

Legacy change: CHANGELOG-LEGACY row 88.

Overlaps to expect at merge: #552 (`TopicReaderView.swift`, `TopicReaderModel.swift`, `CHANGELOG-LEGACY.md`), #540 (`TopicReaderView.swift`, GAP file), #551 (GAP file). `TopicReaderView.body` is at 97 lines, near SwiftLint's default error limit of 100.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added an option to mark a private conversation as unread from the reader when available.
  * After confirmation, the conversation returns to the list and remains marked unread. Confirmation or failure feedback is shown, and attempts are prevented while the action is in progress.
* **Bug Fixes**
  * Opening the conversation’s last page clears its locally marked-unread state. Failed or outdated list refreshes no longer immediately lose that state.
* **Documentation**
  * Updated the legacy changelog and migration notes with the mark-as-unread behavior.

Walkthrough

The reader can mark a private-message conversation unread when its page provides the required link. The reader reports the action result. The message list records confirmations, updates local unread state, and refreshes the list. **Changes: Private-message unread action** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Mark-unread link and writer**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderPage.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicPageSource.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Navigation/TopicFlagActions.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Favorites/TopicFlagTestSupport.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Messages/MarkUnreadTests.swift`|Reader pages now carry an optional mark-unread URL. `TopicFlagActions` sends it through the live writer, and test support records the link. Tests cover the captured link and session check.| |**Reader action and outcome reporting**
`App/SwiftHFR/Messages/ReaderMarkUnreadFlow.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Messages/MarkUnreadTests.swift`, `docs/lots/LOT-127-mp-actions.md`|The reader offers the action when a link is available, prevents another request while sending, and displays failures. It reports outcomes to an optional host or shows success feedback in the reader when no host is provided.| |**Message-list state and feedback**
`App/SwiftHFR/Messages/MessageListModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Messages/MessageListView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Messages/MessagesRootView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Messages/MarkUnreadTests.swift`, `docs/CHANGELOG-LEGACY.md`, `docs/migration/GAP-LEGACY-VS-SWIFT.md`, `docs/lots/LOT-127-mp-actions.md`|On success, the list records the confirmation and unread state, closes the marked conversation if selected, and refreshes. Local unread markers clear after a later successful load or when the conversation’s last page is opened. The list displays failures when the reader is no longer selected.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes **Change:** Feature ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant TopicReaderModel participant TopicFlagActions participant LiveTopicFlagWriter participant TopicFlagFlow participant MessageListModel TopicReaderModel->>TopicFlagActions: markUnread(link) TopicFlagActions->>LiveTopicFlagWriter: markUnread(link) LiveTopicFlagWriter->>TopicFlagFlow: markUnread(link, session) TopicFlagFlow-->>LiveTopicFlagWriter: confirmation or failure LiveTopicFlagWriter-->>TopicFlagActions: result TopicFlagActions-->>TopicReaderModel: success message or failure reason TopicReaderModel->>MessageListModel: report outcome through host ``` **Possibly related issues** - ezzz/HFRnow#324: The roadmap identifies LOT-127 as the mark-unread deliverable, and this PR implements the action from the reader. **Possibly related PRs** - [ezzz/HFRnow#488](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/488): Adds per-segment unread counts that use `isUnread`, which this PR extends to include locally marked-unread conversations. - [ezzz/HFRnow#307](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/307): Adds the message-list unread state that this PR extends for confirmed mark-unread actions and subsequent loads. - [ezzz/HFRnow#257](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/257): Adds the reader page model and source that this PR extends to pass the mark-unread URL to the reader action.
Merge Risk: Low · up to 6baf3

If a mark-unread request fails after someone switches conversations and returns, the failure may not be shown. The change is otherwise mergeable with this bounded issue understood or fixed.
Security architecture risk: Low · up to 6baf3

The new action reuses existing account and destination checks, requires explicit confirmation before updating the list, and does not automatically resend uncertain writes. No material security regression was established. Remaining uncertainty concerns server-side behavior and unexercised device and account-switch scenarios. **Retained concerns** No architecture-level concerns identified.
Security review details

**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The inspected path uses one account session to request an unread-state change for one positive private-conversation identifier on the forum host. It introduces no additional credential or administrative authority in this path. Enforcement of conversation membership remains a server-side responsibility not independently verified here. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — Before a page-derived link reaches the authenticated request sink, validation requires HTTPS on forum.hardware.fr, default port, no user information, the exact action path, unique config, cat and post parameters, private-message category and a positive post identifier. The flow requires a valid session check, disables redirects and accepts success only through the expected confirmation classification and mark-unread sentence. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _observed_ — The reader blocks overlapping submissions while sending. Cancellation before exchange prevents submission; exchange failures that may follow submission become unconfirmed outcomes rather than triggering automatic replay. The menu permits a later explicit user retry. - _observed_ — Confirmed local unread state survives failed reloads and superseded loads, and is removed by reopening the last page or a later successful current load. Reconciliation therefore treats a successful subsequent server list response as authoritative. - _inferred_ — Session replacement rebuilds the environment and navigation models. Since the outcome callback captures its initiating list model and the writer retains that environment's session, late completion remains associated with the previous account-scoped model rather than the replacement account's list.
